channelTitle: Most people just drink apple cider vinegar straight, Grandma June ferments hers for weeks
hook: Most people just drink apple cider vinegar straight from the bottle, but the old-fashioned version was fermented for weeks.
ingredientName: Fire cider (fermented apple cider vinegar tonic)
remedy: As a time-honored piece of American folk wisdom, apple cider vinegar infused with garlic, onion, horseradish, and a little honey, left to steep and ferment for several weeks, was strained and taken by the spoonful during cold season as an old-fashioned way to warm up and support the immune system.
steps: Fill a jar with chopped garlic, onion, fresh horseradish, and a few slices of ginger
Pour raw apple cider vinegar over the mix until fully covered, then seal the jar
Let it steep in a cool, dark place for 3 to 4 weeks, shaking every few days, then strain and stir in honey to taste
caution: The strained tonic is strong and acidic, so dilute a spoonful in water before drinking. Avoid if you have acid reflux or stomach ulcers, and those on blood-thinning medication should ask a doctor before eating garlic regularly.
cta: Have you ever made your own fire cider, or does plain apple cider vinegar do the trick for you? Tell Grandma June in the comments.
